explicit_propositions.text: The Blackfoot Clearwater Stewardship Act aims to protect the headwaters of the Blackfoot River and its tributaries.
Senator John Tester has advocated for the Blackfoot Clearwater Stewardship Act for over 10 years.
The Myron Creek Mining Complex, located near Rogers Pass, caused significant environmental damage due to a dam failure in 1975.
The cleanup of the Myron Creek Mining Complex has significantly improved water quality in the Blackfoot River.
The Blackfoot Clearwater Stewardship Act includes provisions for new wilderness designation, including the Mission Mountains Travel Wilderness.
Support for the Act spans diverse groups including outfitters, mountain bikers, snowmobilers, tribes, and county commissions.
Clean water and healthy habitats are critical for sustaining fish, big game, and recreational opportunities.
The Bill has broad bipartisan support, with 73% of senators reportedly supportive.
The cleanup of the Myron Creek site created economic benefits through excavation and hauling industries.
Public advocacy, such as emailing or calling Senators, can influence legislative outcomes.

assumptions.text: Protecting headwaters is essential for maintaining ecological integrity throughout entire river systems.
Collaboration among stakeholders with conflicting interests leads to durable and effective policy solutions.
Future generations deserve access to intact natural landscapes and outdoor recreation opportunities.
Environmental degradation caused by industrial activity can be reversed through sustained public investment and effort.
Political leaders are responsive to constituent pressure and grassroots mobilization.
Natural resources are interconnected; actions in one location affect distant ecosystems.
Montana’s unique outdoor heritage is a source of regional pride and national significance.
Habitat conservation is inseparable from sustainable hunting and fishing traditions.
Historical environmental mistakes should be acknowledged and remedied as moral and civic responsibilities.
Democratic participation through communication with representatives is a legitimate and impactful form of civic engagement.
